links.comparator_used: Zero-shot LLM (no retrieval) for GPT-4o, Claude3.7 and Qwen3
links.outcome: Exam-question accuracy and clinician-rated accuracy, relevance, completeness and understandability of open-ended answers
links.effect: RAG improved accuracy, relevance, and completeness across all three LLMs, with GPT-4o under RAG achieving the highest overall mean score; RAG slightly reduced understandability for Claude3.7 and Qwen3. No numeric values given in the abstract.
links.tradeoff: Slightly reduced understandability (linguistic accessibility) of answers for Claude3.7 and Qwen3 with RAG.
links.quote: RAG integration improved accuracy, relevance, and completeness across all three LLMs, with GPT-4o under RAG configuration achieving the highest overall mean score.
